activities_fee_ck.name: activities_fee_ck
activities_fee_ck.value: (`activities`.`fee_type` = 'free' and `activities`.`fee_amount_cents` is null) or (`activities`.`fee_type` = 'paid' and `activities`.`fee_amount_cents` is not null and `activities`.`fee_amount_cents` > 0)

activities_cancellation_ck.name: activities_cancellation_ck
activities_cancellation_ck.value: (`activities`.`lifecycle` = 'cancelled' and `activities`.`cancelled_at` is not null and `activities`.`cancellation_reason` is not null and `activities`.`cancellation_registration_count` is not null) or (`activities`.`lifecycle` <> 'cancelled' and `activities`.`cancellation_registration_count` is null)

activity_operations_actor_ck.name: activity_operations_actor_ck
activity_operations_actor_ck.value: (`activity_operations`.`actor_type` = 'member' and `activity_operations`.`actor_member_id` is not null and `activity_operations`.`actor_admin_account_id` is null) or (`activity_operations`.`actor_type` = 'admin' and `activity_operations`.`actor_admin_account_id` is not null and `activity_operations`.`actor_member_id` is null)

activity_operations_reason_ck.name: activity_operations_reason_ck
activity_operations_reason_ck.value: `activity_operations`.`action` not in ('cancel', 'remove', 'restore') or `activity_operations`.`reason` is not null

members_inviter_ck.name: members_inviter_ck
members_inviter_ck.value: (`members`.`kind` = 'platform_root' and `members`.`inviter_member_id` is null) or (`members`.`kind` = 'member' and `members`.`inviter_member_id` is not null)

app_id.name: app_id
app_id.type: varchar(64) character set utf8mb4 collate utf8mb4_0900_bin

open_id.name: open_id
open_id.type: varchar(128) character set utf8mb4 collate utf8mb4_0900_bin

union_id.name: union_id
union_id.type: varchar(128) character set utf8mb4 collate utf8mb4_0900_bin

registrations_status_ck.name: registrations_status_ck
registrations_status_ck.value: (`registrations`.`status` = 'active' and `registrations`.`cancelled_at` is null) or (`registrations`.`status` = 'cancelled' and `registrations`.`cancelled_at` is not null)

registrations_attendance_ck.name: registrations_attendance_ck
registrations_attendance_ck.value: (`registrations`.`attended` = false and `registrations`.`attended_at` is null and `registrations`.`attendance_marked_by_member_id` is null) or (`registrations`.`attended` = true and `registrations`.`attended_at` is not null and `registrations`.`attendance_marked_by_member_id` is not null)
